title: Overloading
concept: An overloaded piece is one asked to defend two things at once. Take one job away — by capture or threat — and it cannot cover the other.
tip: Spot an enemy piece guarding two squares or pieces. Attack one of them and watch the other fall.

feedback.correct: Well spotted! That piece had two jobs and could not do both — you overloaded it.
feedback.hint: Which enemy piece is defending more than one thing? Challenge one of its duties.
feedback.reveal: Force the overloaded piece to choose. Whichever job it drops, you take what it stops guarding.
